metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Sidestory, the VS Code extension that shows sidestories beside your code.

plugins.name: sidestory
plugins.description: Write sidestories: step-by-step walkthroughs of code with diagrams and interactive widgets, beside the code in VS Code.

plugins.description: Read and answer Sidestory comment threads, and receive the comments you send with Ask Claude in VS Code (needs Node 20 or later).
